content: Cyberpunk 2077 is heading to the big screen. Deadline reports that CD Projekt Red’s popular sci-fi video game franchise is being adapted into a live-action film by Paramount Pictures. There’s no details just yet on when the film might premiere. But Deadline says that Lorenzo di Bonaventura, who is known for producing the Transformers films, will be a producer on the movie. “We’re excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise,” says CD Projekt Red joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski. “We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time.” Despite its rocky 2020 launch, Cyberpunk 2077 has gone on to become a huge success for CD Projekt Red, with the company recently announcing that the game has surpassed more than 40 million copies sold. The franchise has also been adapted into a hit Netflix anime, and a second season of that show is debuting later this month. A sequel to Cyberpunk 2077, which CD Projekt Red is calling “Cyberpunk 2,” is in development as well, with the studio reporting recently that the game has 184 people working on it. The news of the Cyberpunk 2077 movie is arriving shortly after the completion of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery’s megamerger under the Skydance name. Paramount is also working on a Call of Duty film for 2028 and the Street Fighter movie debuting on October 16th. Update, October 8th: Added comment from CD Projekt Red’s joint CEO.
chineseTitle: 派拉蒙正在制作《赛博朋克 2077》电影

chineseContent: 《赛博朋克 2077》即将登陆大银幕。据 Deadline 报道，派拉蒙影业正在将 CD Projekt Red 广受欢迎的科幻视频游戏系列改编成真人电影。目前还没有关于这部电影何时首映的详细信息。但 Deadline 表示，因制作《变形金刚》电影而闻名的洛伦佐·迪·博纳文图拉将担任这部电影的制片人。 CD Projekt Red 联合首席执行官 Michał Nowakowski 表示：“我们很高兴派拉蒙成为未来的合作伙伴，与我们分享我们对赛博朋克系列的创意抱负。” “我们期待在适当的时候分享更多细节。”尽管《赛博朋克 2077》在 2020 年发布时表现不佳，但 CD Projekt Red 仍然取得了巨大成功，该公司最近宣布该游戏的销量已超过 4000 万份。该系列还被改编成热门 Netflix 动漫，该剧的第二季将于本月晚些时候首播。 《赛博朋克 2077》的续作（CD Projekt Red 称之为“赛博朋克 2”）也在开发中，该工作室最近报告称该游戏有 184 名人员参与制作。 《赛博朋克 2077》电影的消息是在派拉蒙和华纳兄弟探索公司以 Skydance 名义完成大型合并后不久传出的。派拉蒙还在制作 2028 年上映的《使命召唤》电影和 10 月 16 日首映的《街头霸王》电影。 10 月 8 日更新：添加了 CD Projekt Red 联合首席执行官的评论。
